description: Performs an HTTP request to an external service when triggered. Supports GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and PATCH. URL, headers, and body can be static (config) or dynamic (input).

inputs.name: Trigger
inputs.description: Rising edge fires the HTTP request. Ignored while a request is in flight.

inputs.name: URL
inputs.description: Dynamic request URL. Overrides the URL config when non-empty.

inputs.name: Headers
inputs.description: Dynamic headers as Key:Value pairs separated by |. Overrides config when non-empty.

inputs.name: Body
inputs.description: Dynamic request body. Overrides the body config when non-empty.

outputs.name: Status
outputs.description: HTTP status code of the last response. 0 means no request has been made yet.

outputs.name: Response
outputs.description: Response body text from the last request.

outputs.name: Response headers
outputs.description: Response headers serialized as a JSON object string.

outputs.name: Success
outputs.description: True if the last response status was in the 2xx range (200-299).

outputs.name: Busy
outputs.description: True while a request is in flight. Trigger is ignored while busy.

config.name: Method
config.description: HTTP method to use for the request.

config.name: URL
config.description: Static request URL. Used when the URL input is empty.

config.name: Headers
config.description: Static headers as Key:Value pairs separated by |. Used when headers input is empty.

config.name: Body
config.description: Static request body. Used when the body input is empty.

state.name: Previous trigger
state.description: Previous trigger value for rising edge detection.

state.name: In flight
state.description: True while waiting for an HTTP response.
